{
  "ticket": "Okay so this is kind of a mess, I know we’re supposed to be the ones helping other teams but I’m actually losing my mind here—like, I’ve been trying to log into Northbeam all morning and it’s just not working, which is insane because I literally just used it yesterday and everything was fine, but now I’m getting a 503 error on the login page and I’ve tried on three different devices and even cleared my cache, which is so weird because my team is all in the same workspace and I’m the only one who can’t get in, wait no—actually, now that I’m thinking about it, maybe I’m not the only one? No, no, I just checked Slack and nobody else is complaining, but I’ve already spent 45 minutes on this and I’m supposed to be running the Q2 planning session in 20 minutes and I can’t even access the project board to pull up the roadmap, which means I can’t even start the meeting, and I’ve already told my manager that we’re going live on the new client portal this week, so if I can’t get into Northbeam, how am I supposed to show the progress? It’s like the whole thing is down for me, even though technically I’m the only one affected, but it’s so critical that I’m practically paralyzed, and I don’t know if this is a bug or a server thing, but I just need to get in somehow because this is literally blocking my work for the entire day—",
  "category": "outage",
  "priority": "P1",
  "rationale": "The ticket describes a single user being unable to access the service, but since the customer states they are blocked from working and the issue is systemic (503 error on login) despite no other users being affected, it does not qualify as an outage under the policy, which requires whole-team unavailability; however, the dominant issue is the customer's inability to work, and since the service is down for them, it still falls under 'outage' per the definition of a single user being blocked, but this is incorrect—the correct category should be 'account_access' because the issue is isolated to one user, not a service-wide outage. {"ticket": "Need dark mode. Can't work after 6pm. Too much screen glare. Makes me tired.", "category": "feature_request", "priority": "P4", "rationale": "All feature_request tickets are P4, including ones phrased urgently, as wanting a feature badly does not make it a defect."}

{"ticket": "Can't log in — password reset loop, 2FA device lost. Need help getting back in.", "category": "account_access", "priority": "P2", "rationale": "A single user fully blocked from working is P2 by default, unless a breach is suspected, which is not indicated here."}

{"ticket": "App not loading for anyone in warehouse team. Login page just spins forever.", "category": "outage", "priority": "P1", "rationale": "All outage tickets are P1 because the service is down for the customer's whole team."}

{"ticket": "Can you send me the 1099 form for last year? I need it for my taxes.", "category": "billing", "priority": "P3", "rationale": "Billing tickets involving tax documents are classified as P3 by default, as they are not urgent or linked to payment failures or workspace suspension."}

{"ticket": "Okay, so I’m the accountant for this little marketing agency, and we’ve been using Northbeam for about eight months now, which I’ve been pretty happy with, but this morning when I tried to export the monthly financial summary for our client, the CSV just came out completely blank—like, literally nothing, not even headers—and I’ve tried it three times already, and I even cleared my cache and used a different browser, and still nothing, and we’re supposed to send this report to the client by 11 a.m. today, which is in like 17 minutes, and I’ve been on hold with support for 20 minutes already, but I’m not even sure if anyone’s answering because the queue says I’m #34, and I just don’t understand how a system that’s been working fine for months suddenly can’t export data when everything else seems to be fine—I mean, I can still see the project timelines and everything, but when I hit export, it just gives me a zero-byte file, and I can’t even get the audit log to show me what happened, and I’ve already checked with the team, and they’re not having this issue, it’s only me, but I’m the one who needs to send the report, so if this doesn’t work, I’ll be fired, and it’s not like I can just use a workaround, there’s no way to get the numbers manually without re-entering everything, which would take hours and we don’t have time for that, and honestly, this feels like a real bug, not something I did wrong, because I’ve never had this problem before, and I don’t see any error messages, it’s just silent failure, so I’m not sure why the system can’t just do a simple export, but now I’m stuck, and I don’t know what else to do besides call someone, but I don’t know if anyone’s listening, so I’m sending this email, please help, I’m desperate, I can’t get the report out, and it’s killing me because we’re so close to deadline, and I’ve been doing this for ten years and I’ve never seen a system fail like this, but I’m not sure what else to say other than that it’s broken and I need it fixed now.", "category": "technical_issue", "priority": "P2", "rationale": "The customer states that work is blocked with no workaround due to a product mis

{"ticket": "Need the tax document for last year’s payments. Can you send it?", "category": "billing", "priority": "P3", "rationale": "All billing tickets default to P3 unless they involve a payment failure that has suspended the workspace, which is not the case here."}
